Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Dink Winkerson here live for Danville Today. In the heat, in the sun, alarmingly dehydrated. But whatever. Tonight, the ongoing manhunt for the Danville Mother Mugger, a devious, masked criminal who snatches umbrellas from people's moms. Ya can't make this stuff up! And we talked to some socially awkward astronomers who apparently discovered a new meteor hurtling towards Earth, or something.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And now, without any further ado, ladies and gentlemen, I present to you...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Please say, "Bread Bowl Hot Tub".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...the world's largest...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bread Bowl Hot Tub!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...zoetrope!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And if by "zoetrope", ya mean a 19th century optical toy consisting of a cylinder with pictures on the inner servers that produce the illusion of motion, I'm not impressed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's like a flip book on a wheel.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ooh, we should name it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: "Tropey McTropeFace!" There, move on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Tropey McTropeFace. You girls ready?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, animation is so easy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughs maliciously, gathers her hairdryer and towel) Must bust, must bust, must bust, must bust! (goes back for her shirt, laughs some more)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry for the lair entrance power outage, Agent P, but someone plugged a hairdryer into the wrong outlet.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (entering with glossy hair) My bad, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyhoo, authorities have found an unusual number of things turned on their sides. A John P. Trystate statue, a Mr. Dribbles ice cream, and there's a mailbox that fell over three weeks ago, and now it's upright again, which is ready to receive mail, so I guess that's a good thing. These sideways objects have Doofenshmirtz written all over them. Now I know you have a hard out at noon, so you can skip the pleasantries and go straight to thwarting.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, how unexpected...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, wait! Whoa, whoa, wait, what, n-no trap? No monologuing? I-It's like you're no longer interested in a fully nuanced relationship! Okay, okay, behold, my turnover-inator! And n-no, it doesn't make delicious turnovers, but it could. It could. There's an attachment.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, the turnover-inator is to turn over the leadership of City Hall...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...and it will actually turn City Hall onto its side. Roger will slide out, and I'l run in and take his place. Unless he's lying down, at which point he will suddenly be standing up, and then he will become confused and run away. It's a win-win.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oof! Just.. Aha!

Name: The gang
Dialog: (lovingly) Tropey McTropeFace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wai-wai-wai-wait! It's vanishing already? It's barely nine a.m.! Ugh, whatevs. I've got a hard out at noon anyway.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Now he belongs to the world.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, Ferb, you comin'?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm a little busy here, Candace. If this is your daily call about your brothers, can I get a rain check?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, pffft, it's not that. I mean, they did build something, but it's long gone already. No, I just had a question, what did you say I had to do for chores today?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You promised to give Perry a bath. Aaah!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey! That's my umbrella! It's the Danville Mother Mugger! How do you even know I'm a mother?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I dunno who I should be angrier at, the Mother Mugger or whoever built that giant zoetrope. That's dangerous.

Name: Police chief
Dialog: Be on the lookout for the Mother Mugger! In hindsight, we shoulda had him take off his mask for the mugshot, but we work with what we got.

Name: Police chief
Dialog: Well, well, well! What goes around comes around!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Man, these family reunions with our traditional custom of felling a tree together can get awfully tense.

Name: Biffany
Dialog: Of course, we should start the tree chopping ritual now!

Name: Vanny Van Stomm
Dialog: I vehemently disagree. We should cut it down in a little while!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (grabbing a ladder) Hey, everybody, what say we put aside our differences long enough to enjoy this unexpected, comically large wheel?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (in reverence) Tropey McTropeFace...

Name: Biffany
Dialog: Let's cut the tree down now!

Name: Vanny Van Stomm
Dialog: Yeah! It's a little while later!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (waving goodbye) It is the ephemeral nature of things (wiping away a tear) that make them all the more beautiful.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: A touching sentiment.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't ya have anywhere else ta be?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: We lost our paddle wheel! Oh, without that paddle wheel, we're goners!

Name: Captain
Dialog: If we file every combustible substance at the back of the boat, and create a massive explosion, it may propel us forward.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: But it may explode us, too!

Name: Captain
Dialog: Everyone's a critic.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: (pointing up) Wait! What's that?

Name: Captain
Dialog: Well, I'll be... Ow!

Name: Man 1
Dialog: We're okay! I mean, not great, obviously, but okay!

Name: Captain
Dialog: In retrospect, maybe we shouldn't have named the boat Explodey McSplodeFace.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, no fair! Now I can't reach my inator button!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, it's not even noon and you're already leaving? What... What am I supposed to do for the rest of the day?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, twelve o'clock. Let's get this over with. (Puts on her goggles.) Perry! Oh, there you are, Perry. Oh! And you're filthy!  This has got to be the highlight of your week, right? Y'know, cuz platypuses don't do much.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters happily as Candace scrubs him down)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Officer, I wanted to report— Oh! That's the man who stole my umbrella!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Dink Winkerson? Disturbingly UV-sensitive host of Danville Today? But why steal umbrellas?

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: (getting cuffed and hauled away) Because every day, they send me out in the broiling sun to report on nonsense! I just wanted to be in the shade, lady! (as if he's on camera) This is Dink Winkerson (winks) being arrested!

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: You ordered ten tons of bread dough? How're we supposed to roll it out?

Name: Biker
Dialog: That zoetrope taught me how to love!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Time to turn this city on its head!

Name: Norm
Dialog: On its head, sir?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Or technically, I guess, turn it on its side. Y'know, it just doesn't sound as good. You say, "I'm gonna turn this city upside-down", people get that. But ya say something about, "I'm gonna rotate this city 90º"? That, that... that doesn't mean anything to anybody.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did you guys just hear somethin'?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It sounded like it might have been a large cylindrical object colliding with a huge flaming rock, sending them both careening into space. (Beat.) Or maybe just the building settling.

Name: Dinosaur
Dialog: Finally, a new hospitable home planet.

Name: Zoetrope Deity
Dialog: It is not your time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Finally! My hour of triumph!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Now I've been turned 90º.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'see? That means nothing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, inexplicably large and enigmatic zoetrope!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great idea, Phineas. A Ferris wheel ride is the perfect end to the day.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey, there are now two Ferris wheels!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And that one looks just like Tropey McTropeFace!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Aw, he found a friend.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Way to go, Tropey! Hey, look at me! I'm a hamster!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, look! Were those little baby merry-go-rounds here before?
